head: Clackity flip clock app turns the iPhone Duo into a desk clock
dek: Clackity is a new split-flap clock app that looks and sounds like an old train station departure board, made for the iPhone Duo and working on any iPhone. It was #7 in Utilities on the US App Store's paid chart on November 14.
details: Small flaps around the time show the date, weather, sunrise and sunset and your battery. Swipe the clock to set a timer that ends with a chime. Folded into a tent, the iPhone Duo stands on a desk, and a lit ring around the camera shows the weather and the timer; other iPhones use the Dynamic Island. It has five typefaces, costs 2.99 dollars, is made by Brian Lowen and came out on November 12.
where: iPhone (made for iPhone Duo), App Store, 2.99 dollars
means: If you want your phone to double as a bedside or desk clock, this one is built for that, with the weather and a timer on the same screen.
todo: The flip sound can be turned off if you use it on a nightstand.
